compatibility: Against the SV2-CTX-04 response every field is unchanged; the response gains a top level receipt, null when no signing key is configured. Stats gain context_receipt_validation_failures. Exact replays return the same receipt.
rollback_rehearsal: Unsetting BRAIN_RECEIPT_KEYS keeps context served with receipt null and verification answering receipts_not_configured (test_unconfigured_signing_keys_keep_context_and_refuse_verification). Receipt-required gates in agentihooks must be returned to observe mode before that, or before any incompatible signing change. Receipts write no authoritative object; graph entities are untouched.
limitations: Delivery acknowledgements are per process and are lost on restart.
Receipts are HMAC signed with shared keys, so any holder of a key version can verify and mint receipts for that brain; key distribution is a deployment concern.
Shared task packs for another agent are not issued; a receipt verifies only for its own execution.
A receipt proves retrieval and delivery, never comprehension by the model.
